|lore=Admiral Ackbar’s hit-and-fade tactics force the Imperial Navy to spread throughout the galaxy in a futile attempt to engage the Rebels.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt, may stack it here. To play any new Interrupt of same name, players must first stack it here. May place this Effect in Lost Pile (place cards here in owners’ Used Pile) to retrieve a starship. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The [[Strikeforce (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster limits the initial once-per-game stack to an Interrupt the opponent just played. It retrieves any starship, using the ordinary specific-card destination of the Used Pile. The Gold slip restricts retrieval to a Rebel starship and sends it to hand. Both have a Grabber icon, which moves from the box to the type strip. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=1 Players Committee Gold Edition sheet, p. 1, slip 15]. [[:File:VS11O-15-Strikeforce.png|Publisher slip]].
